title: Image Ripple
summary: A cover-cropped photograph with radial WebGL ripples — play, loop, cursor-follow origin, and scrubbers for speed, count, and width up to 500%.

blocks.content:
I wanted a ripple sitting on top of a photo that you could actually steer — and that stayed sharp when you swapped the image.

This one cover-crops whatever photo you drop in, then lets you play/pause, loop, radiate from the center or the cursor, and scrub speed, how many ripples go out, and band width up to 500%.
When reduced motion is on, the canvas is skipped and the still photograph stays.
